text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan II urges Moslems to support the holy city of al Qods (Jerusalem).
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali pledges 15 billion dirhams to finance local projects in the Moroccan northern provinces.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri calls on the European Union countries to cooperate with his country on drug trafficking and clandestine immigration.
- Commerzbank increases its stake in Moroccan bank.
- Meknes court sentences woman to 10 years in jail for torturing her maid.
- Istiqlal opposition leader M'Hamed Boucetta says his party must contribute to Morocco's democracy success to pull the country out of its crisis.
